name: std::filesystem::directory_entry::is_regular_file
intro:
Checks whether the pointed-to object is a regular file. Effectively returns:

1) std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status()).

2) std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status(ec)).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ec

 -

 out-parameter for error reporting in the non-throwing overload

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the referred-to filesystem object is a regular file, false otherwise.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
Any overload not marked noexcept may throw std::bad_alloc if memory allocation fails.

1) Throws std::filesystem::filesystem_error on underlying OS API errors, constructed with p as the first path argument and the OS error code as the error code argument.

2) Sets a std::error_code& parameter to the OS API error code if an OS API call fails, and executes ec.clear() if no errors occur.
